reviewer: Assistant visually inspected the complete two category contact sheets of original held-out render views, before any model inference on this cohort.
basis: Four full-body table lamps and four complete single cushions, two clearly identifiable front or mild side views per product. No floor lamps, multiple light heads, thin cushion edge, rear-face target, chair, table or paired seat cushion. Selection uses only original product appearance and view completeness, never model scores.
evaluation_policy: Independent of recorded native Qwen warm-start TRAIN and development cohorts in both roles. Prepare only; freeze checkpoint and protocol before inference. Existing 96 development rows remain unchanged; this cohort is never a training cache or an early-stop input.
